description: Preview the TCGplayer CSV rows for 1 to 25 exact Pokemon inventory copies. Call this after the seller selects the copies. Returns staged-preview rows and CSV, plus excludedCount and excluded for copies left out. It queues nothing, publishes nothing, and offers no export follow-up.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

itemIds.description: The exact Item ids selected by the seller, 1 to 25 unique non-empty values. Required; each copy must be owned or listed, belong to Pokemon, and not already be live on TCGplayer.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns every selected Pokemon inventory copy. Required.

name: spellbook_pokemon_tcg_staged_preview
